slices.focus: South Hills visit with calm older rescue dog shifts Derek from flat no on a dog to conditional maybe
slices.summary: A visit to a cousin with a newly adopted older rescue dog surprises Derek by being calm and low-drama, challenging his long-standing resistance to getting a family dog. He shifts from 'no dog ever' to 'maybe eventually, after specific conditions' — the basement cleaned, the yard fence tested and reliable, and a modest pet budget established. He and Erin discuss older rescue specifics (medium energy, leash manners, home-trained) and plan a practical sequence: test the fence, maybe dog-sit for a weekend, then look at rescues by summer if the household routine holds.
